import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Ensure entity_ids is a list for consistent indexing
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    
    # Step 1: Identify valid orders placed BEFORE seed_time to avoid data leakage
    valid_orders = db["orders"][
        db["orders"]["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time
    ]["order_id"].unique()
    
    # --------------------------
    # 1. Aggregate Order Items Features (core product sales metrics)
    # --------------------------
    filtered_order_items = db["order_items"][
        (db["order_items"]["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)) &
        (db["order_items"]["ts"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()
    
    # Base sales aggregations
    sales_agg = filtered_order_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        first_sale_ts=("ts", "min"),
        last_sale_ts=("ts", "max")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Recency features (relative to seed_time)
    sales_agg["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg = sales_agg.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"])  # Drop non-numeric datetime columns
    
    # Time-windowed sales trends (30/60/90 days before seed_time)
    windows = {
        "orders_30d": seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30),
        "orders_60d": seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60),
        "orders_90d": seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    }
    for col_name, cutoff in windows.items():
        window_sales = filtered_order_items[
            filtered_order_items["ts"] >= cutoff
        ].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().rename(col_name)
        sales_agg = sales_agg.merge(window_sales, on="product_id", how="left")
        sales_agg[col_name] = sales_agg[col_name].fillna(0)
    
    # Ratios to capture recent activity momentum
    sales_agg["ratio_30_to_90"] = sales_agg["orders_30d"] / (sales_agg["orders_90d"] + 1e-9)
    sales_agg["ratio_60_to_90"] = sales_agg["orders_60d"] / (sales_agg["orders_90d"] + 1e-9)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 2. Aggregate Review Features
    # --------------------------
    filtered_reviews = db["reviews"][db["reviews"]["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)].copy()
    # Link reviews to products via order_items
    review_product = filtered_reviews.merge(
        filtered_order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    
    review_agg = review_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "nunique"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
        review_response_rate=("review_answer_timestamp", lambda x: x.notna().mean())
    ).reset_index()
    
    # --------------------------
    # 3. Aggregate Payment Features
    # --------------------------
    filtered_payments = db["payments"][db["payments"]["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)].copy()
    # Link payments to products via order_items
    payment_product = filtered_payments.merge(
        filtered_order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    
    payment_agg = payment_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        most_common_payment_type=("payment_type", lambda x: x.mode()[0] if not x.mode().empty else "unknown")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Encode categorical payment type as numeric code
    payment_agg["payment_type_code"] = pd.factorize(payment_agg["most_common_payment_type"])[0]
    payment_agg = payment_agg.drop(columns=["most_common_payment_type"])
    
    # --------------------------
    # 4. Aggregate Order & Delivery Features
    # --------------------------
    filtered_orders = db["orders"][db["orders"]["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)].copy()
    # Link orders to products via order_items
    order_product = filtered_orders.merge(
        filtered_order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    
    # Calculate delivery timing metrics
    order_product["purchase_to_approval_days"] = (
        order_product["order_approved_at"] - order_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    order_product["purchase_to_carrier_days"] = (
        order_product["order_delivered_carrier_date"] - order_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    order_product["purchase_to_customer_days"] = (
        order_product["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    order_product["estimated_vs_actual_days"] = (
        order_product["order_estimated_delivery_date"] - order_product["order_delivered_customer_date"]
    ).dt.days  # Positive = delivered early, negative = late
    
    # Status frequency features
    status_agg = order_product.groupby(["product_id", "order_status"]).agg(
        status_count=("order_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index()
    status_pivot = status_agg.pivot(
        index="product_id",
        columns="order_status",
        values="status_count"
    ).reset_index().fillna(0)
    status_pivot.columns = [
        f"order_status_{col}" if col != "product_id" else col
        for col in status_pivot.columns
    ]
    
    # Delivery performance aggregations
    delivery_agg = order_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_purchase_to_approval_days=("purchase_to_approval_days", "mean"),
        avg_purchase_to_carrier_days=("purchase_to_carrier_days", "mean"),
        avg_purchase_to_customer_days=("purchase_to_customer_days", "mean"),
        avg_estimated_vs_actual_days=("estimated_vs_actual_days", "mean"),
        on_time_delivery_rate=("estimated_vs_actual_days", lambda x: (x >= 0).mean())
    ).reset_index()
    
    # --------------------------
    # 5. Merge all features and handle missing values
    # --------------------------
    # Initialize result with all input entity_ids (ensures full coverage)
    result = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids}).set_index("product_id")
    
    # Merge all aggregated features with left join to preserve all input entity_ids
    aggregations = [
        (sales_agg, "product_id"),
        (review_agg, "product_id"),
        (payment_agg, "product_id"),
        (delivery_agg, "product_id"),
        (status_pivot, "product_id")
    ]
    for agg_df, key_col in aggregations:
        agg_idx = agg_df.set_index(key_col)
        result = result.join(agg_idx, how="left")
    
    # --------------------------
    # 6. Impute missing values and add synthetic features
    # --------------------------
    # Fill count-based columns with 0 (no activity)
    count_cols = [
        "total_orders", "total_items", "total_revenue", "total_freight",
        "unique_sellers", "orders_30d", "orders_60d", "orders_90d",
        "total_reviews", "total_payments"
    ]
    status_cols = [col for col in result.columns if col.startswith("order_status_")]
    count_cols.extend(status_cols)
    result[count_cols] = result[count_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # Fill average/ratio columns with 0 (neutral value for no activity)
    avg_cols = [
        "avg_price", "std_price", "avg_freight", "avg_review_score",
        "std_review_score", "avg_payment_value", "avg_installments",
        "avg_purchase_to_approval_days", "avg_purchase_to_carrier_days",
        "avg_purchase_to_customer_days", "avg_estimated_vs_actual_days",
        "on_time_delivery_rate", "review_response_rate",
        "ratio_30_to_90", "ratio_60_to_90"
    ]
    result[avg_cols] = result[avg_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # Fill recency columns with large value (simulate "cold" product with no history)
    max_recency_days = (seed_time - pd.Timestamp("2016-01-01")).days
    result[["days_since_first_sale", "days_since_last_sale"]] = result[
        ["days_since_first_sale", "days_since_last_sale"]
    ].fillna(max_recency_days)
    
    # Fill payment type code with -1 (unknown category)
    result["payment_type_code"] = result["payment_type_code"].fillna(-1).astype(int)
    
    # Synthetic derived features for signal strength
    result["has_sales_history"] = (result["total_orders"] > 0).astype(int)
    result["recency_score"] = 1 / (result["days_since_last_sale"] + 1)  # Normalized 0-1: higher = more recent
    result["frequency_score"] = (result["total_orders"] / (result["days_since_first_sale"] + 1)) * 30  # Avg orders per 30 days
    result["monetary_score"] = result["total_revenue"] / (result["total_orders"] + 1)  # Avg revenue per order
    
    # --------------------------
    # 7. Finalize output: reindex to match input entity_ids order
    # --------------------------
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    return result

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Только заказы, совершённые до seed_time
    valid_orders = orders.loc[
        orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time, "order_id"
    ]
    valid_orders = set(valid_orders)

    # Позиции заказов: ts = момент покупки -> до seed_time
    fi = items[
        items["ts"].notna()
        & (items["ts"] < seed_time)
        & items["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)
    ].copy()

    base = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids}).set_index("product_id")

    # --------------------------
    # 1. Продажи
    # --------------------------
    sales_agg = fi.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        first_sale_ts=("ts", "min"),
        last_sale_ts=("ts", "max"),
    ).reset_index()

    sales_agg["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg = sales_agg.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"])

    for col_name, cutoff in [
        ("orders_30d", seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)),
        ("orders_60d", seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60)),
        ("orders_90d", seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)),
        ("orders_180d", seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)),
    ]:
        w = fi[fi["ts"] >= cutoff].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
        sales_agg[col_name] = sales_agg["product_id"].map(w).fillna(0)

    sales_agg["ratio_30_to_90"] = sales_agg["orders_30d"] / (sales_agg["orders_90d"] + 1e-9)
    sales_agg["ratio_60_to_90"] = sales_agg["orders_60d"] / (sales_agg["orders_90d"] + 1e-9)
    sales_agg["rev_90d"] = fi[fi["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)].groupby(
        "product_id"
    )["price"].sum()
    sales_agg["rev_90d"] = sales_agg["product_id"].map(
        fi[fi["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)].groupby("product_id")["price"].sum()
    ).fillna(0.0)

    sales_agg = sales_agg.set_index("product_id")
    base = base.join(sales_agg, how="left")

    # --------------------------
    # 2. Отзывы (только созданные до seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    fr = reviews[
        reviews["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)
        & reviews["review_creation_date"].notna()
        & (reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()

    rp = fr.merge(fi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(), on="order_id", how="inner")

    review_agg = rp.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "nunique"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
        avg_review_lag_days=(
            "review_creation_date",
            lambda x: (x - x.index.to_series().astype("datetime64[ns]").min()).mean().days
            if len(x) > 0
            else 0,
        ),
    )
    review_agg = review_agg.drop(columns=["avg_review_lag_days"])
    base = base.join(review_agg, how="left")

    # Свежие отзывы (последние 90 дней)
    fr_recent = fr[fr["review_creation_date"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
    rp_recent = fr_recent.merge(fi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
                                on="order_id", how="inner")
    rev_recent = rp_recent.groupby("product_id")["review_score"].agg(["count", "mean"])
    rev_recent.columns = ["reviews_90d", "avg_review_score_90d"]
    base = base.join(rev_recent, how="left")

    # --------------------------
    # 3. Платежи (только по заказам, случившимся до seed_time; payment ts уже учтён через ts заказа)
    # --------------------------
    fp = payments[payments["order_id"].isin(valid_orders)].copy()
    # Отфильтруем платежи, у которых ts есть и он из будущего (защита)
    fp = fp[fp["ts"].isna() | (fp["ts"] < seed_time)]
    pp = fp.merge(fi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(), on="order_id", how="inner")

    payment_agg = pp.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
    )
    ctype = pp.groupby("product_id")["payment_type"].agg(
        lambda x: x.mode().iloc[0] if not x.mode().empty else "unknown"
    )
    payment_agg["payment_type_code"] = pd.factorize(ctype)[0]
    base = base.join(payment_agg, how="left")

    # --------------------------
    # 4. Доставка: используем только даты, уже известные к seed_time
    # --------------------------
    prod_orders = fi[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates().merge(
        orders, on="order_id", how="left"
    )

    # Каждое событие учитываем, только если его дата уже наступила (< seed_time)
    for src, tgt in [
        ("order_approved_at", "app"),
        ("order_delivered_carrier_date", "carr"),
        ("order_delivered_customer_date", "cust"),
    ]:
        known = prod_orders[src].notna() & (prod_orders[src] < seed_time)
        col = tgt + "_delay"
        prod_orders[col] = np.where(
            known,
            (prod_orders[src] - prod_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
            np.nan,
        )

    known_est = prod_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"].notna()
    prod_orders["est_gap"] = np.where(
        known_est,
        (prod_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"] - prod_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days,
        np.nan,
    )

    known_del = prod_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() & (
        prod_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time
    )
    prod_orders["on_time"] = np.where(
        known_del & prod_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"].notna(),
        (prod_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"]
         <= prod_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).astype(float),
        np.nan,
    )

    delivery_agg = prod_orders.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_approval_delay=("app_delay", "mean"),
        avg_carrier_delay=("carr_delay", "mean"),
        avg_delivery_days=("cust_delay", "mean"),
        avg_estimated_days=("est_gap", "mean"),
        on_time_rate=("on_time", "mean"),
    )
    base = base.join(delivery_agg, how="left")

    # Доля заказов с известным статусом delivered на момент seed_time
    delivered = prod_orders["order_status"].eq("delivered")
    base["delivered_rate"] = prod_orders.assign(d=delivered).groupby("product_id")["d"].mean()

    # --------------------------
    # 5. Заполнение пропусков
    # --------------------------
    count_like = [
        "total_orders", "total_items", "total_revenue", "total_freight",
        "unique_sellers", "orders_30d", "orders_60d", "orders_90d", "orders_180d",
        "total_reviews", "reviews_90d", "total_payments", "rev_90d",
    ]
    for c in count_like:
        if c in base.columns:
            base[c] = base[c].fillna(0)

    neutral_fill = 0.0
    for c in base.columns:
        if c not in count_like:
            base[c] = base[c].fillna(neutral_fill)

    max_recency = (seed_time - pd.Timestamp("2016-09-01")).days
    base["days_since_first_sale"] = base["days_since_first_sale"].fillna(max_recency)
    base["days_since_last_sale"] = base["days_since_last_sale"].fillna(max_recency)
    base["payment_type_code"] = base["payment_type_code"].fillna(-1).astype(int)

    # --------------------------
    # 6. Синтетические признаки
    # --------------------------
    base["has_sales_history"] = (base["total_orders"] > 0).astype(int)
    base["recency_score"] = 1.0 / (base["days_since_last_sale"] + 1.0)
    base["frequency_score"] = base["total_orders"] / (base["days_since_first_sale"] + 1.0) * 30.0
    base["monetary_score"] = base["total_revenue"] / (base["total_orders"] + 1.0)
    base["items_per_order"] = base["total_items"] / (base["total_orders"] + 1e-9)
    base["review_rate"] = base["total_reviews"] / (base["total_orders"] + 1e-9)

    base = base.reindex(entity_ids)
    base = base.fillna(0).astype(float)
    return base
